name: Setter AI – AI Chatbot for Appointment Booking & Lead Generation
author: josefsetterai

sections.description:
Setter AI – AI Chatbot for Appointment Booking & Lead Generation embeds a smart chat bubble on any WordPress site.
It greets visitors, answers questions with business-specific knowledge, qualifies prospects through conversational AI, and books meetings directly into your calendar (Calendly, Google, Outlook).

Key Benefits

  • 24/7 lead capture – Engage every visitor instantly; no more missed inquiries.
  • Instant scheduling – Integrated date-time picker lets prospects lock a slot on the spot.
  • Business-trained AI – Upload FAQs, service pages, or PDFs so the bot sells like a seasoned rep.
  • Plug-and-play – One-click install; no coding or theme edits required.
  • Lightweight – Asynchronous script adds <30 KB and won’t slow your site.

Typical Use Cases

  • Agencies & freelancers – auto-book discovery calls
  • Real-estate & home services – qualify leads, schedule viewings
  • SaaS & B2B sites – replace “Book a demo” forms
  • Coaches & clinics – fill calendars while you sleep

Integrations

Calendly • Google Calendar • Outlook • HubSpot • Pipedrive • Zapier • Make • Custom webhooks

External Services

This plugin relies on an external JavaScript file to provide its core chatbot functionality. The script is hosted on jsDelivr: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/trysetter/website-widget@releases/chatbot-widget.js
This script is required to load and run the Setter AI chatbot widget on your site. Without it, the plugin cannot display or operate the chat interface.
When used, the plugin connects to TrySetter — a service operated by the plugin author — to serve and initialize the chatbot widget. Users must create a free Setter AI account at https://www.trysetter.com/ to obtain a Bot Integration ID.
By using this plugin, visitor data such as IP address, browser type, and interaction history may be processed for functionality, personalization, and analytics. Setter AI may also connect to third-party services (e.g., Calendly, Google Calendar) for booking features.
Service Provider: TrySetter
– Script source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net
– Terms: https://www.trysetter.com/terms-and-conditions
– Privacy Policy: https://www.trysetter.com/privacy

Support

Questions? Chat with us at https://www.trysetter.com or email support@trysetter.com. We reply within one business day.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/setter-ai directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Setter AI.
  4. Paste your Bot Integration ID from your Setter AI Dashboard.
  5. Connect your Calendly or native calendar if needed.
sections.faq:
Where can I get my Bot Integration ID?

Go to https://www.trysetter.com, log in, and copy your Bot ID from Bot Settings → Integration.

Do I need a Calendly account?

Yes, to book meetings directly. You can also use Google Calendar, Outlook, or other integrations.

Can I use this on client websites?

Yes, Setter AI is perfect for agencies managing multiple client sites.
